description_en: Upgrades the versions of cluster component instances so that you can benefit from the feature optimizations in the new versions

kebab_example: aliyun cs upgrade-cluster-addons --cluster-id cf4299b79b3e34226abfdc80a4bda0000 --biz-body component_name=coredns version=v1.11.3.2-f57ea7ed6-aliyun config=CpuRequest_:_800m next_version=v1.11.3.5-5321daf49-aliyun policy=canary --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeClusterAddons
